name: gll-longitude-180-west
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.10 (the text wire), dm 18000.00000 W = -180; encode m = round(180*60*1e5) = 1080000000, degrees 180 fit 3 digits; lat 0000.00000 S decodes to -0 and encodes with P (m = 0), so S becomes N. Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program (Python standard library).
